_declared_before_results: Every threshold below was written before the first run. Do not edit after seeing an outcome; add a new config file instead.
_why_a_projection: Phase66F applied DINOv2 to an unchanged volume and lost 0.091 log loss. Two top-ten solutions independently measured pretrained extractors on this modality at +0.05 log loss, -0.018 AUROC, and acquisition-conditional collapse across clusters. A ~9 mm point spread function at 2 mm sampling means the volume is roughly twice oversampled, so capacity is not the bottleneck and a raw volume is the wrong input. This experiment gives the foundation model a physically meaningful 2D representation instead, which is the only form in which it has not yet been falsified.

projection._purpose: Fixed, zero-parameter reduction of the superior-inferior axis into four physical channels. A learnable version of this collapsed to near rank-1 in a published solution, so the fixed form is not a simplification, it is the measured optimum.
projection._reference: Each scan is divided by the mean of its own voxels above 0.15 x its 99.9th percentile before projection. Relative end to end, so the 0.46x-2.3x global gain the gamma augmentation applies cancels exactly and tau measures the patient, not the camera.

augmentation._purpose: Physics-consistent, exaggerated in amplitude but never in form. Every single removal of an equivalent chain lost in a published ablation.
augmentation._no_absolute_threshold: The gamma operation is a 0.46x-2.3x GLOBAL GAIN on mean-normalised input. Any absolute intensity cut is therefore wrong by up to 2.3x during training and exactly right at validation. Smooth reductions survive this; thresholds do not.

arms._purpose: Three arms, one harness, identical input. The scratch control is the point: it is the matched null that says whether DINOv3 contributed anything at all, as opposed to the representation contributing everything.

backbone._offline_only: No download is attempted. Weights must be present locally and are verified by digest before use, matching the Phase65A-R3 offline contract.

seeds._purpose: Three seeds per arm. The measured standard deviation is reported before any arm comparison is read, and the ship bar must exceed it.

leave_one_cluster_out._purpose: The read neither top-ten solution had. An in-distribution gain of roughly 0.007-0.010 from changing the training distribution is the known signature of fitting the acquisition mix harder, so a candidate must also survive being validated on an acquisition cluster it never trained on.

ship_bar._purpose: DINOv3 must beat the scratch control ON THE SAME REPRESENTATION. Beating the old raw-volume baseline proves only that the projection works.
